sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): his wide barbarian run, the big sword trailing low behind him, the LEGS CHANGING OVER (under the kilt)
sheets.weapons: HIS HANDS AND THE SWORD go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the big curved sword, as long as in image 1, held low, raised, swung or flung as the pale figure holds it; the free hand open, clenched or thrust forward as the pale figure's. The pale figure of his ult is the old frame's body without its fire: do NOT draw fire. Only him: no red fury glow, no fire, no afterimages; the gems' cyan stays inside the gems.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) planted straight down under his hips, its foot flat on the ground; the FAR leg (the darker one) kicked up and back behind him, bent, its foot high off the ground. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must look different: a different leg planted, the other one kicked back. Never the same leg in front in every frame (Senna's first run did that, and Talon's: 「走路没有换腿」).
